title: The Death of Marketing: AI agents as customers and what indie founders should do
summary: John argues AI agents will make most buying decisions, so human-oriented marketing (SEO, ads, funnels) fades. Four channels survive: government lists, genuinely best product, human identity purchases, and paid AI placements. Bootstrapped founders should focus on the best product in a niche and a personal-brand audience.

principles.text: Your customer is increasingly an AI agent with a task and a budget, not a loyal human, so marketing playbooks built for humans are decaying.
principles.quote: Your customer is now an AI agent with a task, a budget, and zero brand loyalty.

principles.text: In the long run AI agents will run real evaluations, so the genuinely best product for a use case wins; gaming reviews is short-term.
principles.quote: The endgame: the best product wins. Every time. For every specific use case.

principles.text: Short term, be listed everywhere (launchpads, directories, listicles, ratings) since AI recommends based on those today.
principles.quote: Short-term game: be listed everywhere you can, on all launchpads, directories, listicles, ratings...

principles.text: Bootstrapped founders should be the best at one specific niche job; go long-tail to reduce competition.
principles.quote: The single best strategy here is to go after long-tail niche markets, just so that you reduce the competition and aim at being the best or one of the best among a few.

principles.text: Personal brand is the strongest remaining moat: people buy founders (the T-shirt effect), which AI cannot replicate.
principles.quote: Personal brand is the strongest moat that’s left. The founder with 100K followers who share their journey will outsell the faceless SaaS with a bigger feature set. Every time.

principles.text: Paid AI placements will be pay-to-play and price out bootstrappers, so skip them and the government-list channel.
principles.quote: This will be massive. It will also be pay-to-play. The companies spending millions on Google Ads today will redirect those budgets to AI placement. If you’re bootstrapped, you’re priced out of this channel too.
